name: Field Notes
concept: Analytics dressed as a magazine: full-bleed landscape, serif headline, monospace figures inline in prose.

type.families: Three voices, deliberately. A serif for headlines (Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Source Serif), a neo-grotesque for UI and body, and a monospace (JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono) for every figure, date and code.
type.hierarchy: Headline serif 48/54 regular, ending in a full stop · deck 18/28 sans regular · body 15/24 sans · figures mono 14/20 · issue labels 10/12 mono ALL-CAPS 0.14em.
type.usage: Headlines end with a period — magazine grammar. Monospace figures appear *inline in running prose*, not just in tables. Letterspaced ALL-CAPS mono for section and issue labels.

tokens.texture: A translucent white page sheet (`rgba(255,255,255,.86)`, optional `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)`) floats over a full-bleed defocused landscape photograph. Surfaces are otherwise print-flat. Corners are softly rounded (16-20px) on the sheet, square on internal rules. A faint grain is acceptable over the photograph only.
tokens.layout: A page, not a screen. One centred column (max 720px) of content sitting on the sheet, with the photograph bleeding to all four edges behind it. 8px scale, 32-40px sheet padding, hairline rules between sections instead of cards. Data, when present, is set as a magazine table — ruled, mono, right-aligned.

best_for: brands with real photography to spend

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as landscape photograph, natural light, slightly defocused.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- full-bleed natural landscape — hills, field, forest, sky
- soft overcast or golden-hour light, no harsh sun
- muted natural greens and earth tones, low saturation
- slight defocus so the image reads as a backdrop, not a subject
- horizon placed low or high, never centred

NEGATIVE SPACE: The centre must be quiet and low-contrast so a white sheet of type can sit on it.

DO NOT INCLUDE: people looking at camera, urban or industrial scenes, high saturation, HDR processing, vector or 3D rendering, text in the image.

image_recipe.model: configurable — set to your image model
image_recipe.resolution: 1536x1024 (3:2 landscape); use 1024x1536 for portrait, 1024x1024 for square
